notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

The following update mainly contains bug fixes for people who play with a controller (1.50% of you! :D):


Unlocking the secret achievement will now also unlock the achievements of all unfortunate cats involved that have not been found yet.

 Fixed a bug where panning with 3x zoom while playing with a controller would sometimes not scroll all the way to the edge of the picture.

Fixed a bug where the back button on the top left would be visible when clicking on play with timer mode active after regularly finishing the game while using a controller.

Fixed a bug with 3x zoom where it would jump straight to the fireworks upon finding the last cat without playing the trumpet sound and animation first.

Unlocking timer mode now gets saved immediately upon finding the last cat to prevent losing progress if you close or ALT+F4 the game before returning to the menu.

Some players mentioned the game closed unexpectedly. I couldn't figure out why, but I added one security measure to hopefully prevent that from happening. 

Some players mentioned not all cat achievements had unlocked upon finishing the game, which sometimes could be caused by unstable internet connections. Upon finding the last cat, I added a check to unlock all 98 cat achievements. 

Peace & Love
Patrick

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
I fixed a bug that would soft block the game if you finished the game by finding the hidden achievement. 

It's a rather obscure bug but players who found the hidden achievement can imagine how this bug could have been discovered haha
